cloudformation.unit: one template file is one stack
cloudformation.method: exact: the resource type is named in the template and the role is a property of it. Intrinsics are normalised so the YAML and JSON forms of one reference compare equal.

cdk.unit: one directory is one app, because two stacks in one app can share a role across two files
cdk.method: heuristic: the source is read, not synthesised. Two call sites passing the same expression text are treated as one role. A call site whose role argument cannot be located is undecidable, never 'not sharing'. A file counts only if it imports bedrockagentcore, because CfnRuntime is not unique across CDK modules.

why: the Terraform population in which a cross-agent chain is possible is 18 projects, and 0 of 18 bounds the rate at only 15.3 percent. This measures how much of the population was outside Terraform.
do_not_add_these_together: the two units differ and the CDK figure is heuristic while the CloudFormation one is exact. Report them separately.
